BiblicalUsage: The word appears once, in Deborah's song, as the gallop of the horses whose hooves break in the charge. It is the sound of a battle already won.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a single gallop in Scripture is there to make us hear what God did.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
